text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
In The Souls of Black Folk (1903), W. E. B. Du Bois picked ten master songs among the spirituals, and called the last of them, Steal Away, the song of songs.

source.en: W. E. B. Du Bois, The Souls of Black Folk (1903), "The Sorrow Songs" (Standard Ebooks edition)

In an 1880 printing, every verse and the chorus end on the same line, and each verse shares its third line too: only the opening pictures change, from thunder to lightning to bending trees.

source.en: University of Virginia, Uncle Tom's Cabin & American Culture, "Steal Away" (text from J. B. T. Marsh, The Story of the Jubilee Singers With Their Songs, 1880)
